verdict.rationale: Lium documents its own cluster product: several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric for one distributed job, which covers multi-node and fast interconnect. General renting is self-serve (no-email signup, card or ACH payment, browserless agent rental), but the evidence never says clusters themselves can be provisioned without contacting sales. missing for 10: evidence that clusters are self-serve (CLI/API/UI provisioning flow), cluster sizes and interconnect specs, cluster pricing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
